description: This file contains unit tests for the FileBasedTenantService class, which manages tenant data with file persistence. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito to verify startup behavior, tenant loading, saving, and modifications, as well as conversion logic for tenant objects.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantServiceTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the FileBasedTenantService class, verifying startup scenarios, tenant data persistence, loading, modification restrictions, and object conversion.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the service instance before each test.

methods.name: testDoStartCreatesFile
methods.description: Verifies that the service creates the tenants file during startup if it does not exist.

methods.name: testDoStartFailsIfFileCannotBeCreated
methods.description: Checks that startup fails if the tenants file cannot be created.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoresMalformedJson
methods.description: Ensures startup proceeds even if the tenants file contains malformed JSON.

methods.name: testDoStartLoadsTenants
methods.description: Verifies tenants are loaded correctly from an existing tenants file during startup.

methods.name: testDoStartWithStartEmptyIgnoreTenants
methods.description: Tests startup behavior when 'startEmpty' is enabled, preventing tenant loading.

methods.name: testLoadTenantsCanReadOutputOfSaveToFile
methods.description: Confirms that tenants saved to file are reloaded correctly, maintaining data integrity.

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceedsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Tests that adding a tenant succeeds when modification is disabled (contradictory; intended to verify behavior).

methods.name: testRemoveTenantsFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Checks that tenant removal is forbidden when modification is disabled.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantsFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Confirms that updating tenants is forbidden when modification is disabled.

methods.name: testConversion
methods.description: Validates the conversion of Tenant objects into JSON structures suitable for persistence.
